speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Reduced FVC and FEV1 with a normal FEV1/FVC ratio, indicating a restrictive pattern.

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry results showing a restrictive pattern are significant; have you noticed any difficulty taking a deep breath or a sensation of tightness in your chest? Additionally, do you have a history of lung exposure to asbestos, silica, or other industrial dusts?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I definitely feel like I can't take a full deep breath and sometimes feel tightness in my chest. Regarding industrial dusts, I work as a mechanic, so I've been around exhaust fumes and metal shavings for most of my life.

speaker: Doctor
text: That history of occupational exposure combined with your restrictive lung pattern is very suggestive of pneumoconiosis. Have you noticed any crackling sounds when you breathe in deeply, and do you have any family history of similar lung issues? REQUEST TEST: High_Resolution_CT_Chest

text: RESULTS: Bilateral interstitial infiltrates suggestive of pulmonary fibrosis. No pleural effusion or pneumothorax observed.

speaker: Doctor
